Myself Beyonce's "Me I" — original release 2003. "Me, Myself and I" is a song by American singer Beyoncé from her debut solo album Dangerously in Love (2003).

Artist: Myself Beyonce · Title: Me & I · Album: Beyoncé - Me, Myself And I · Year: 2003 · Genre: Funk / Soul · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Myself Beyonce - Me & I.mp4.

It was written by Beyoncé, Scott Storch and Robert Waller and produced by Storch with guitar played by Aaron Fishbein.

Beyoncé decided that she wanted a deeper and more personal song as the third single; the song was sent by Columbia Records and Music World Entertainment to contemporary hit radio in the United States on October 19, 2003.
